model_family: GLM, GLMM, and GAM survival threshold family
predictors_or_structure: log_size, size class thresholds, region smooths, study/location/coral/year random effects
caveat: NOAA dominance and mortality-definition heterogeneity limit direct transfer to restoration settings.

model_family: LM, LMM, GLMM, GAM, and quantile-regression growth threshold family
predictors_or_structure: log_size smooths/thresholds, region interactions, study/location/year/coral random effects
caveat: Growth measurement intervals and area allometry vary among source studies.

model_family: GAM, LM, LMM, ANCOVA, and permutation-style growth comparison family
response: AGR, RGR, positive growth, and log final size
predictors_or_structure: log initial size, population type, study, region, size class, matched overlap groups
caveat: AGR/RGR contrasts can reflect geometry and size range as much as biological rate differences.

model_family: GLM, GLMM, LMM, ANOVA, and variance-partitioning diagnostics
predictors_or_structure: study, year, size class, region, interactions, random effects
caveat: Used for interpretation of variance sources, not as a primary claim estimator.

model_family: GLMM, LM, likelihood-ratio, and climate overlay family
predictors_or_structure: DHW, survey year, cohort/year curvature, size, study, region, disturbance indicators
caveat: Temporal and DHW terms are observational overlays with uneven regional coverage.

model_family: GLM simulation and power-analysis family
predictors_or_structure: treatment effect size, sample size, study variance, size class, region
caveat: Simulation assumptions are planning aids and should not be read as fitted ecological effects.

model_family: GLM, GAM, LM, and LOSO cross-validation family
predictors_or_structure: log_size, threshold indicators, size class, study-held-out folds
caveat: Leave-one-study-out performance is sensitive to NOAA leverage and sparse non-NOAA folds.

model_family: Chi-square, GLM, GLMM, and context comparison family
predictors_or_structure: natural/restoration/lab/nursery context, log_size, study, overlap-zone filters
caveat: Context comparisons are confounded by geography, study design, and starting size distributions.

model_family: GLM, GLMM, LM, and LMM candidate model-selection table
predictors_or_structure: null, linear, quadratic, threshold, categorical, region, study random effects
caveat: AIC/ranking tables are diagnostics for the workflow, not a separate inferential endpoint.

model_family: Study-level rma per size class plus Lefkovitch matrix, bootstrap, elasticity, and stochastic projection family
response: size-class survival, growth transitions, fecundity, lambda, elasticities
predictors_or_structure: study-level annual survival effects, size-class transition rates, fecundity scenarios, bootstrap draws
caveat: Population projections inherit the constant-hazard annualization and survival pooling assumptions.

model_family: Random-effects rma, subgroup, moderator, publication-bias, and LOO meta-analysis family
predictors_or_structure: population type, size, fragment percentage, year, region, study effects
caveat: Tier-1-only synthesis is retained as a reference because the expanded model is the main synthesis.

model_family: Three-level rma.mv primary meta-analysis with rma sensitivity and moderator families
predictors_or_structure: nested study effects, population type, region, risk of bias, classification scenarios, moderators
caveat: High heterogeneity and dependent regional effects make model structure central to interpretation.

model_family: Random-effects rma, moderator regression, and heterogeneity decomposition family
predictors_or_structure: study, population, size class, fragment percentage, year, subregion
caveat: Moderator tests have limited power and should qualify, not replace, pooled estimates.

model_family: GLM, bootstrap, matrix, LOSO, boundary, outlier, mortality, and fecundity sensitivity family
response: survival forms, lambda, and sensitivity metrics
predictors_or_structure: leave-one-out studies, size boundaries, outlier exclusion, interval length, fragmentation/fecundity assumptions
caveat: Sensitivity rows are robustness bounds around the main matrix and survival workflows.

model_family: Bootstrap-parameter serialization for downstream RSE demographic model
response: parameter distributions for survival, growth, lab, nursery, and recruitment
predictors_or_structure: reads transition/meta-analysis outputs and writes RDS parameter-list objects
caveat: Bridge script does not fit the primary model; it preserves fitted parameter distributions for downstream simulation.

model_family: GLM and LM display fits for natural versus restoration overlap plots
predictors_or_structure: population type, log_size, overlap-zone subsets
caveat: Figure-side fits are visual summaries; script 29 carries the durable comparison outputs.

model_family: GLM and GAM verification fits for canonical statistics
predictors_or_structure: log_size, null survival model, size smooths, canonical-output checks
caveat: Verification fits are consistency checks and should not be cited as independent analyses.

model_family: GAM and LM diagnostic figure fits
predictors_or_structure: log_size smooth, study random-effect smooth, quadratic growth residual diagnostics
caveat: Figure-side refits should stay aligned with scripts 02, 03, and 12.

model_family: GAM and LM figure-side fits for threshold, AGR/RGR, and allometry panels
response: survival, AGR, RGR, positive growth, and allometric exponent
predictors_or_structure: log_size smooths, positive-growth smooths, log final size allometry
caveat: Figure-side fits should mirror the frozen model outputs from scripts 02 through 04.

model_family: rma, GLM, GLMM, fixed-effect, and size-matched natural/restoration comparison family
response: survived and log odds of survival
predictors_or_structure: population type, log_size, region, study, size class, Florida overlap filters
caveat: Residual confounding remains because restoration and natural records differ by place, design, and disturbance history.

model_family: rma, GAM, GLMM, exclusion, and interval-sensitivity disturbance family
response: survival log odds, survival probability, and lambda-related summaries
predictors_or_structure: disturbance exclusion status, disease exclusion, any-disturbance exclusion, Neely interval comparisons, study effects
caveat: Disturbance exclusions depend on reconstructed event histories and uneven monitoring windows.

model_family: GLMM and rma subset heat-stress overlay family
response: survived and log odds of annual survival
predictors_or_structure: max DHW, log_size, study, site-year heat stress, meta-analysis subset flags
caveat: DHW coverage is incomplete and strongest claims should remain attribution-limited.

model_family: GLMM disturbance-state and DHW survival family
predictors_or_structure: disturbance state, DHW, log_size, study, region, event-window assignment
caveat: Disturbance windows are reconstructed from external chronology and should not be treated as randomized contrasts.

model_family: GLMM interaction family for generic disturbance state by colony size
response: survived and positive growth / growth outcome
predictors_or_structure: disturbance state, log_size, interaction term, study random effects
caveat: Generic disturbance categories pool different stressor mechanisms.

model_family: GLMM interaction family for storm, disease, and heatwave disturbance types
predictors_or_structure: disturbance type, log_size, interaction term, DHW-centered heatwave gradient, study random effects
caveat: Typed stressor strata are thinner than the generic disturbance-state model and should be treated as mechanism checks.

model_family: GLMM or GLM survival state model plus alive-state transition model
response: multistate annual survival and alive-state transitions
predictors_or_structure: current state, log_size, study random effects, observed alive transitions
caveat: Not frozen into manuscript claims; useful for testing shrinkage/retrogression state dynamics.

model_family: nlme longitudinal size model plus discrete-time hazard GLM
predictors_or_structure: previous and current size, growth trajectory, interval duration, study/coral structure
caveat: Two-stage approximation should be treated as exploratory until fully cross-validated.

model_family: GAM survival/growth models embedded in stochastic disturbance IPM
response: survival, growth, lambda, and projected abundance
predictors_or_structure: log_size smooths, disturbance regime, regime transition matrix, stochastic projection draws
caveat: Projection results are scenario explorations and not the canonical lambda estimate.

model_family: GLM year-deviation model and latent regime classification family
predictors_or_structure: year random deviations, size, survival state, inferred regime transition probabilities
caveat: Latent states summarize year effects and should not be read as confirmed disturbance causes.

model_family: GLMM and LMM distributed-lag disturbance model family
predictors_or_structure: current and lagged disturbance exposure, log_size, study random effects
caveat: Lag terms are exploratory because exposure histories and monitoring windows are uneven.

model_family: Cox recurrent-event/frailty and terminal mortality model family
predictors_or_structure: start-stop intervals, size, study/coral clustering, frailty or cluster effects
caveat: Requires richer interval/event interpretation than the manuscript's main annual survival model.

model_family: GAMM-style spatiotemporal hierarchical survival and growth model family
predictors_or_structure: size smooths, year smooths, spatial smooths, site/study random effects, region-blocked CV
caveat: Spatial predictions are exploratory because monitoring density is highly uneven.

model_family: GLMM or GLM restoration-age survival sensitivity model
predictors_or_structure: log_size, years since outplant, study random effect fallback
caveat: Graceful placeholder behavior means absence of usable outplant-age covariates is itself informative.

model_family: GLMM or GLM winter-SST survival sensitivity model
predictors_or_structure: log_size, winter anomaly, interaction, study random effect fallback
caveat: Currently limited by availability of winter-SST covariates at the observation scale.

model_family: GLMM or GLM microhabitat-depth survival sensitivity model
predictors_or_structure: log_size, depth_m, study random effect fallback
caveat: Currently limited by availability and harmonization of depth covariates.
